name: AI evaluation concurrency, deduplication and bounded cost
authorization: User explicitly approved Tasks 7-14 main merges/automatic deploys, and separately approved 0072 source, tests and production function. No additional production variables are changed.

migration.change: Invoker-only atomic admission function over the existing 0071 operational counter table. No learner table/column/data changes. PUBLIC, anon and authenticated execution revoked; fixed search_path. Apply before new code becomes ready.

covered_paths: Writing translation, pattern and activation checks
Coach Grammar, Vocabulary, Writing, Speaking and assignment evaluations
implementation.admission: Four independent global active leases and one active call per owned/authenticated learner across workers; no admission queue. Hour ceilings 2000 globally and 120 per user; deployment overrides may lower ceilings only.
implementation.deduplication: Private identical requests share the inline owner, with at most 16 followers. Cancelling a follower does not cancel its owner. A bounded 128-entry / 2 MiB cache and HMAC shared request lease last three minutes. Different users never share results. Existing durable grade/evaluation uniqueness prevents regrading completed work.
implementation.cost: One provider attempt. No native automatic retry of timeouts, malformed outputs or other errors, even if legacy AI_PROVIDER_MAX_ATTEMPTS requests more. Existing input ceiling 60000 serialized characters and output ceiling 5000 tokens/call retained; no dollar-price claim.
implementation.io: Total provider deadlines 20s text, 60s STT and 12s sense selection; streamed response byte caps 200000/100000/50000. Existing 24 MiB transcription recording cap retained.
implementation.database: One dedicated operational connection uses the same strict Supabase TLS verification and statement_cache_size=0. No ordinary academic pool client or operational lock is held during provider I/O. Ordinary pool 5 + event listener 1 + AI budget 1 = 7 sockets per worker, 14 during two-worker deployment overlap, below allocation 40 out of 60 after reserve 20. Connection shutdown is bounded.
implementation.integrity: Prompts and scoring contracts preserved; invalid output objects rejected. Existing evaluations are checked against their owner, including the persistence race. Speaking finalization is conditional on owner, recording status and the same object key. No DB/file/tool capabilities are sent to the provider.
implementation.provider_configuration: Both native bridges use validated registry entries, preventing rejected raw entries from shadowing a valid provider ID. HTTPS, credentials/port/query/fragment and IP/local-host checks apply. Request payloads cannot supply provider URLs or secrets.
